buildings.name: Drone Pad
buildings.effect: Unpacks scout drones from stock into its two bays, charges them and launches them to tiles inside comms coverage.
buildings.description: A small landing pad with two charging bays, a hangar box and an antenna mast. Make scout drones at a Machine Shop: once the pad is finished it takes one from stock into each empty bay and charges it. LAUNCH sends a charged drone flying straight to a tile inside comms coverage (your colony cores' antennas, or a relay satellite), surveying what it passes; it circles there, flies home, lands in its bay and recharges. Automated (no crew), it needs power and wears like any machine. Salvaging it puts its docked drones back in stock.
